Harbour Ledger, 1788

The brig Endeavour arrived from Lisbon on 3 May 1788 carrying cork, salt and port wine. The harbour master, Mr. Josiah Penrose, recorded a duty of £14 6s.

Café owners on the quay complained that the new excise fell hardest on small traders.
